data.name: Emera
data.gender_notes: Emera is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'emera', meaning 'ever-shining'. This name is derived from the Greek goddess 'Emera', symbolizing eternal light and perpetual youth. The name Emera carries the meaning “Ever-shining” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Emera usually hope their child will grow to embody ever-shining and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A beacon of light in the darkness, illuminating the path towards spiritual growth.
data.etymology: Emera belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Ever-shining.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Emera total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hebrew.name: אמרה
in_hebrew.meaning: אמרה - נאמרת, מילה של אלוהים, דבר אלוהים
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אמרה הוא שם שמקורו בשפה העברית ומשמעותו 'נאמרת' או 'מילה של אלוהים'. הוא קשור למושג של דבר אלוהים או דבר ה', שמצוי בכתבי הקודש. השם מעיד על קשר הדוק עם אלוהים ועל חשיבות הדבר האלוהי בתרבות היהודית והנוצרית.

in_greek.name: Ἐμέρα
in_greek.long_meaning: Ἐμέρα προέρχεται ἀπό τὴν ἑλληνικὴν γλῶσσαν καὶ σημαίνει 'λαλητός' ἤ 'ῥήτωρ', δηλαδή αὐτὴ ποὺ λαλεῖ ἤ αὐτὸς ποὺ διαγγέλλει. Ἐν ἐνίων κειμένων, ἡ λέξις συνδέεται μὲ τὴν ἰδέα τοῦ λόγου ἢ τοῦ ῥήματος τοῦ Θεοῦ, καθιστώντας τὸ ὄνομα Ἐμέρα στενά συνδεδεμένο μὲ τὴν πνευματικὴν παράδοση τῆς Ἐκκλησίας.

in_latin.name: Emera
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Emera originem in linguis semiticis habet et significationem 'dicta' vel 'verbum Dei' habet. Est nomen profundam connotationem spiritualem habens, quia verbum Dei in traditione christiana et biblica fundamentum revelationis et communicationis divinae constituit.

The name Emera is associated with qualities of spirituality, faith, and divine connection.
